text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"While I was running... in my neck, my 
hands, my back, my legs. ...Shivers rushed 
through my entire body."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno-san's breathing, and my own ragged 
breath, kept echoing in my head over and 
over.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My chest swelled with the feeling that I 
just didn't want to lose—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
That was a thrilling contest! First place 
goes to...—!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!! 
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Yaeno-san and I screamed, as if vomiting 
out all the frustration balled up inside 
us.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Because I wanted to win. Maybe to the two 
of us, beating our rival means—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (—Because it meant taking 1st place.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, this is what competition is. The 
shouts of your "present" piercing right 
through my skin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I will definitely join you all. 
At the Derby... I shall engrave my 
present.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I... I lost... I tried my very hardest to 
win, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Even so, I... hah... I lost...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ugh, uuu... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm zzooo fruzztrateddd...!! 
Waaaaahhhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I've shown you such a 
pathetic sight.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In terms of count, it was only dropped a 
single time, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't know I could feel this 
frustrated.
choice_data_list:
Because it was a showdown where we gave it 
our all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I seeee... You're right, so this is what 
competing is all about...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaah... ngh, phew...! Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I may not have taken 1st place today, 
but... I won't hand over the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Even if my opponent is Yaeno-san. Or 
Ardan-san, who will surely stake 
everything on the next race."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Because my feelings for the Derby are 
stronger than anyone's."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh... From Dad? I wonder what's up...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Awawa, I am so sorry for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Hello, Dad?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Chiyo, I heard you worked really 
hard on rehabilitating your injury.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe... yeah. It's pretty much all 
healed up. Ah, but because of that, our 
tatami mats at home—"

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Mom told me about it. Said the 
tatami mats in the Japanese-style room 
were completely shredded.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wahya~... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. Because that's proof of all 
your hard work, Chiyo."

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Your dad used to ruin the tatami mats 
just like that back in the day, too! A 
matching badge of honor! Hahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Dad.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Chiyo. I hear you're challenging the 
Derby. Is your dream waiting for you 
there?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ――…… Yeah, I do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to fulfill the dream entrusted to 
me by the person I look up to there.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, the other girls have poured all 
their time and heart into this as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My rivals are all determined not to lose 
to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's why the Derby is my biggest race.

The next target was the race of her 
dreams: the Japanese Derby.
